providers.organization: RSUP Prof. Dr. I.G.N.G. Ngoerah (Ministry of Health central general hospital)

location.locationNote: Main public referral hospital for Bali and Nusa Tenggara (formerly Sanglah Hospital). The Australian Consulate list gives Jl. Kesehatan Selatan 1, Sanglah.

providers.hours: Outpatient clinics Mon–Fri 07:30–16:00 WITA, closed on public holidays; registration Mon–Thu 07:00–13:30, Fri 07:00–13:00. Emergency department 24 hours.

services.note: The hospital lists a VCT (voluntary counselling and testing) clinic among its outpatient polyclinics, plus a dermatology and venereology (Kulit dan Kelamin) clinic and a methadone clinic. HIV treatment: a 2022 detikBali report says the internal medicine department's tropical and infectious diseases division was caring for 2,550 people with HIV on antiretroviral treatment, and a doctor there said he has many foreign patients. PrEP and PEP are not mentioned; for PEP out of hours go to the 24-hour emergency department (IGD).

providers.hours: Outpatient clinics Mon–Fri 07:30–16:00 WITA, closed on public holidays; registration Mon–Thu 07:00–13:30, Fri 07:00–13:00. Emergency department 24 hours.

services.note: The hospital lists a Diabetic clinic, an internal medicine clinic, a nutrition (Gizi) clinic and a paediatric clinic among its outpatient polyclinics; the executive Wing Amerta also has internal medicine and paediatric clinics. Its site publishes a series on diabetes nutrition therapy. Children's diabetes care, endocrinologists, pumps and CGM aren't named on the pages; ask. For urgent problems (very high or low blood sugar) use the 24-hour emergency department.

providers.hours: Outpatient clinics Mon–Fri 07:30–16:00 WITA, closed on public holidays; registration Mon–Thu 07:00–13:30, Fri 07:00–13:00. Emergency department 24 hours.

services.note: A 2017 Udayana University study used the register of children with ADHD at the hospital's Growth and Development Clinic (Klinik Tumbuh Kembang), 2014–2016. The hospital's current outpatient list shows a paediatric clinic (Poli Anak) and a psychiatric clinic (Poliklinik Jiwa) but doesn't name the growth and development clinic, so ask at registration which clinic sees children with ADHD. Adult ADHD assessment and whether methylphenidate is prescribed aren't stated; ask the psychiatric clinic.

providers.organization: Bali Medika Clinic (supported by Yayasan Bali Peduli)
providers.hours: Mon–Fri 09:00–14:00 and 17:00–21:00; Sat 10:00–14:00 (Travel Gay Asia listing). Confirm by phone.

services.note: Opened in 2011 as Indonesia's first clinic for gay men, MSM and LGBT people. A 2011 Fridae report lists confidential check-ups, STI screening, HIV testing, CD4 testing, antiretroviral treatment, hormone therapy and counselling, open to anyone at risk; Indonesians were treated free and foreigners paid market rates. A current LGBT travel directory lists general practice and sexual health care for the LGBT community. PrEP and PEP aren't mentioned; ask.

sources.title: Bali gets Indonesia's first gay medical clinic (4 Nov 2011)

providers.notes: Service details date mainly from 2011; check current services and hours by phone before visiting.

address.en: Jl. Bypass Ngurah Rai No. 100X, Kuta, Badung, Bali 80361

providers.hours: 24 hours (emergency department, medical centre, laboratory and pharmacy).

services.note: STD screening packages cover HIV, syphilis, gonorrhoea, chlamydia and hepatitis B and C; prices aren't published. PrEP, PEP and HIV treatment aren't mentioned; for PEP go to the 24-hour emergency department and ask. Diabetes: the hospital says it offers comprehensive diabetes care from internists, with blood glucose monitoring and fasting glucose and HbA1c tests in its 24/7 laboratory; no endocrinologist is listed. Psychiatrists and paediatricians also consult here.

providers.organization: Denpasar City Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan Kota Denpasar)

services.note: Community health centre with a VCT clinic (pre- and post-test counselling with an HIV test; HIV diagnosis and therapy) and an STI clinic (examination, treatment, condoms). It continues ART prescribed by the supervising referral hospital. Uninsured patients pay fees set by city regulation; people registered with BPJS here are not charged. ANTARA (Dec 2025) reports that every puskesmas in Denpasar has HIV care, support and treatment services. PrEP isn't mentioned.

sources.title: Denpasar catat kenaikan kasus HIV/AIDS (2 Dec 2025)

address.en: Pertokoan Imam Bonjol Square No. A-17, Jl. Imam Bonjol, Pemecutan Klod, Denpasar Barat, Denpasar

providers.hours: Mon–Fri 09:00–20:00 WITA; Sat 09:00–14:00 WITA, or by appointment. For lab tests arrive at least 1 hour before closing.

services.note: Says it provides STI and HIV testing and treatment plus counselling: HIV rapid test and confirmation, CD4 count and HIV viral load, syphilis tests, swabs and STI PCR panels (gonorrhoea, chlamydia and HPV molecular tests only at this site), hepatitis tests. Non-Indonesians pay contribution fees (from 1 Feb 2026): admin Rp40,000, counselling Rp150,000, HIV rapid test Rp200,000, confirmation Rp200,000. Whether it starts or continues ART, PrEP or PEP isn't stated; ask.

services.note: Psychiatric clinic founded by a group of psychiatrists (opened 2023) with psychiatrists and clinical psychologists, outpatient, inpatient and telehealth care, and programmes for children with special needs. name.en: RSIA Puri Bunda — VidaStana Child Development Center

providers.organization: RSIA Puri Bunda (Puri Bunda Hospital for Mothers and Children)

address.en: Jalan Gatot Subroto IV No. 19, Dauh Puri Kaja, Denpasar Utara, Bali 80233

providers.hours: Developmental paediatrician: Mon, Wed, Thu 17:00–20:00; Fri 16:00–19:00; Sat 10:00–18:00; Sun 17:00–21:00, or by appointment. Psychologist most days; confirm by phone.

services.note: Child development centre with a paediatric developmental specialist (Sp.A(K)) who diagnoses developmental disorders including ADHD, and a clinical psychologist (psychological and IQ testing, counselling). Speech, occupational and physiotherapy and multisensory classes. No doctor's referral is needed. No child psychiatrist is listed, so ask whether ADHD medicine is prescribed here or by referral.

ADHD services, child and adolescent psychiatry and waiting times aren't stated online; call before travelling.
